/* Subcon02Mapper.selectSiteLinkList */ SELECT L.LINK_ID AS linkId , CASE WHEN L.SRC_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'RECEIVED' END AS direction , CASE WHEN L.SRC_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} THEN L.DST_CMPNY_CD ELSE L.SRC_CMPNY_CD END AS otherCmpnyCd , IFNULL(C.CMPNY_NM, '') AS otherCmpnyNm , L.SRC_SITE_CD AS srcSiteCd , IFNULL(SS.SITE_NM, '') AS srcSiteNm , L.DST_SITE_CD AS dstSiteCd , DS.SITE_NM AS dstSiteNm , L.STATUS AS status , DATE_FORMAT(L.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS insertDate , DATE_FORMAT(L.PROCESS_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS processDtime , L.PROCESS_COMMENT AS processComment
, L.CHKPT_LINK_STATUS AS chkptLinkStatus , DATE_FORMAT(L.CHKPT_LINK_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS chkptLinkDtime FROM TB_SITE_LINK L LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CMPNY C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = CASE WHEN L.SRC_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} THEN L.DST_CMPNY_CD ELSE L.SRC_CMPNY_CD END ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE SS ON ( SS.CMPNY_CD = L.SRC_CMPNY_CD AND SS.SITE_CD = L.SRC_SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE DS ON ( DS.CMPNY_CD = L.DST_CMPNY_CD AND DS.SITE_CD = L.DST_SITE_CD ) WHERE (L.SRC_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} OR L.DST_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd}) ORDER BY L.INSERT_DATE DESC, L.LINK_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}

/* Subcon02Mapper.selectActiveRelationCmpnyList */ SELECT CASE WHEN R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} THEN R.TGT_CMPNY_CD ELSE R.REQ_CMPNY_CD END AS cmpnyCd , IFNULL(C.CMPNY_NM, '') AS cmpnyNm FROM TB_CMPNY_RELATION R LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CMPNY C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = CASE WHEN R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} THEN R.TGT_CMPNY_CD ELSE R.REQ_CMPNY_CD END ) WHERE R.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND (R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} OR R.TGT_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd}) ORDER BY cmpnyNm ASC

/* Subcon02Mapper.selectMyActiveSiteList */ SELECT A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.SITE_NM AS siteNm , CASE WHEN A.LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS linkYn FROM TB_SITE A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND IFNULL(A.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SITE_NM ASC

/* Subcon02Mapper.selectActiveRelationId */ SELECT R.RELATION_ID FROM TB_CMPNY_RELATION R WHERE R.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( (R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdA} AND R.TGT_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdB}) OR (R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdB} AND R.TGT_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdA}) ) LIMIT 1

/* Subcon02Mapper.selectSiteLinkById */ SELECT L.LINK_ID AS linkId , L.RELATION_ID AS relationId , L.SRC_CMPNY_CD AS srcCmpnyCd , L.SRC_SITE_CD AS srcSiteCd , L.DST_CMPNY_CD AS dstCmpnyCd , L.DST_SITE_CD AS dstSiteCd , L.STATUS AS status FROM TB_SITE_LINK L WHERE L.LINK_ID = #{linkId}
mapper.insert: /* Subcon02Mapper.insertMirrorSite */ INSERT INTO TB_SITE ( CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , SITE_NO , SITE_NM , ADDR_1 , ADDR_2 , ZIP_CODE , STR_DATE , END_DATE , USE_YN , SITE_ADMIN_CD , TEL_NO , GPS_RANGE , SITE_DESC , LAT , LON , LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD , LINK_SRC_SITE_CD , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{dstCmpnyCd} , #{dstSiteCd} , #{siteNo} , S.SITE_NM , S.ADDR_1 , S.ADDR_2 , S.ZIP_CODE , S.STR_DATE , S.END_DATE , S.USE_YN , NULL , S.TEL_NO , S.GPS_RANGE , S.SITE_DESC , S.LAT , S.LON , #{srcCmpnyCd} , #{srcSiteCd} , #{insertNo} , NOW() , #{insertNo} , NOW() FROM TB_SITE S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{srcSiteCd}

/* Subcon02Mapper.mergeMasterSiteAuthSet */ INSERT INTO TB_USER_SITE_AUTH ( CMPNY_CD , USER_CD , SITE_CD , USE_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.USER_CD , #{siteCd} AS SITE_CD , 'Y' AS USE_YN , #{insertNo} , NOW() , #{insertNo} , NOW() FROM TB_USER A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} /* 테넌트 격리 - 수신 회사 사용자로 한정 */ AND A.AUTH_CD IN ('master', 'hr', 'safe', 'system') /* 전사 접근 역할 + 시스템 관리자 계정 */ ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN) , UPDATE_NO = VALUES(UPDATE_NO) , UPDATE_DATE = VALUES(UPDATE_DATE)

/* Subcon02Mapper.insertMirrorSchAll */ INSERT INTO TB_SCH_MGMT ( CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , SCH_CD , SCH_NO , SCH_TYPE
, APPLY_DATE , FST_SCH_STR_TIME , FST_SCH_END_TIME , FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , FST_BRK_STR_TIME , FST_BRK_END_TIME , SEC_SCH_STR_TIME , SEC_SCH_END_TIME , SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , SEC_BRK_STR_TIME , SEC_BRK_END_TIME , USE_YN , LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD , LINK_SRC_SCH_CD , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{dstCmpnyCd} , #{dstSiteCd} , S.SCH_CD , S.SCH_NO , S.SCH_TYPE , S.APPLY_DATE , S.FST_SCH_STR_TIME , S.FST_SCH_END_TIME , S.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , S.FST_BRK_STR_TIME , S.FST_BRK_END_TIME , S.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME , S.SEC_SCH_END_TIME , S.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , S.SEC_BRK_STR_TIME , S.SEC_BRK_END_TIME , S.USE_YN , #{srcCmpnyCd} , S.SCH_CD , #{insertNo} , NOW() , #{insertNo} , NOW() FROM TB_SCH_MGMT S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{srcSiteCd} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: /* Subcon02Mapper.selectActiveLinksByRelation */ SELECT L.LINK_ID AS linkId , L.RELATION_ID AS relationId , L.SRC_CMPNY_CD AS srcCmpnyCd , L.SRC_SITE_CD AS srcSiteCd , L.DST_CMPNY_CD AS dstCmpnyCd , L.DST_SITE_CD AS dstSiteCd , L.STATUS AS status FROM TB_SITE_LINK L WHERE L.RELATION_ID = #{relationId} AND L.STATUS IN ('PROPOSED', 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY L.LINK_ID ASC

/* Subcon02Mapper.selectActiveLinksBySrcSite */ SELECT L.LINK_ID AS linkId , L.DST_CMPNY_CD AS dstCmpnyCd , L.DST_SITE_CD AS dstSiteCd FROM TB_SITE_LINK L WHERE L.SRC_CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND L.SRC_SITE_CD = #{srcSiteCd} AND L.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND L.DST_SITE_CD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY L.LINK_ID ASC

/* Subcon02Mapper.propagateMirrorSch */ INSERT INTO TB_SCH_MGMT ( CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , SCH_CD , SCH_NO , SCH_TYPE
, APPLY_DATE , FST_SCH_STR_TIME , FST_SCH_END_TIME , FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , FST_BRK_STR_TIME , FST_BRK_END_TIME , SEC_SCH_STR_TIME , SEC_SCH_END_TIME , SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , SEC_BRK_STR_TIME , SEC_BRK_END_TIME , USE_YN , LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD , LINK_SRC_SCH_CD , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{dstCmpnyCd} , #{dstSiteCd} , S.SCH_CD , S.SCH_NO , S.SCH_TYPE , S.APPLY_DATE , S.FST_SCH_STR_TIME , S.FST_SCH_END_TIME , S.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , S.FST_BRK_STR_TIME , S.FST_BRK_END_TIME , S.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME , S.SEC_SCH_END_TIME , S.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , S.SEC_BRK_STR_TIME , S.SEC_BRK_END_TIME , S.USE_YN , #{srcCmpnyCd} , S.SCH_CD , 'SYSTEM' , NOW() , 'SYSTEM' , NOW() FROM TB_SCH_MGMT S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{srcSiteCd} AND S.SCH_CD = #{schCd} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SCH_NO = VALUES(SCH_NO) , SCH_TYPE = VALUES(SCH_TYPE) , APPLY_DATE = VALUES(APPLY_DATE) , FST_SCH_STR_TIME = VALUES(FST_SCH_STR_TIME) , FST_SCH_END_TIME = VALUES(FST_SCH_END_TIME) , FST_SCH_BRK_MIN = VALUES(FST_SCH_BRK_MIN) , FST_BRK_STR_TIME = VALUES(FST_BRK_STR_TIME) , FST_BRK_END_TIME = VALUES(FST_BRK_END_TIME) , SEC_SCH_STR_TIME = VALUES(SEC_SCH_STR_TIME) , SEC_SCH_END_TIME = VALUES(SEC_SCH_END_TIME) , SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN = VALUES(SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN) , SEC_BRK_STR_TIME = VALUES(SEC_BRK_STR_TIME) , SEC_BRK_END_TIME = VALUES(SEC_BRK_END_TIME) , USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN) , LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD = VALUES(LINK_SRC_CMPNY_CD) , LINK_SRC_SCH_CD = VALUES(LINK_SRC_SCH_CD) , UPDATE_NO = VALUES(UPDATE_NO) , UPDATE_DATE = NOW()

/* Subcon02Mapper.insertMirrorSchHist */ INSERT INTO TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST ( CMPNY_CD , SITE_CD , HIST_IDX , SCH_CD , APPLY_DATE , FST_SCH_STR_TIME , FST_SCH_END_TIME , FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , FST_BRK_STR_TIME , FST_BRK_END_TIME , SEC_SCH_STR_TIME , SEC_SCH_END_TIME , SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , SEC_BRK_STR_TIME , SEC_BRK_END_TIME , USE_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) SELECT M.CMPNY_CD , M.SITE_CD , #{histIdx} , M.SCH_CD , M.APPLY_DATE , M.FST_SCH_STR_TIME , M.FST_SCH_END_TIME , M.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , M.FST_BRK_STR_TIME , M.FST_BRK_END_TIME , M.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME , M.SEC_SCH_END_TIME , M.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , M.SEC_BRK_STR_TIME , M.SEC_BRK_END_TIME , M.USE_YN , 'SYSTEM' , NOW() FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND M.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND M.SCH_CD = #{schCd}
